content: Aisek Kousoan nan Kerar
Lehk lapalap ehu ahpw pweida nan sahpwo me tohrohrasang me wiawi ni mwehin Eipraam. Aisek eri kohla rehn Apimelek, nanmwarkien mehn Pilisdia kan, nan Kerar.
KAUN-O ketin pwarohngehr Aisek oh mahsanihongehr, “Ke dehr kohdihla Isip, ahpw mihmihte nan sahpwet, wasa me I ndaiong uhk ke en mihmi ie.
Mihmihte nan sahpwet, I ahpw pahn ieiang uhk oh kupwuramwahwihiuk, pwe I pahn kihong uhk oh kadaudokomw kan sahpw pwukat koaros, pwe I en kapwaiada inou me I wiahiong semomwo, Eipraam.
I pahn katohtowehla kadaudokomw kan duwehte usu en pahnlahng kan, oh kihong irail sahpw pwukat koaros. Wehi koaros pahn peki I en kapaiairailda duwehte ei kapaiadahr kadaudokomw kan.
I pahn kapaiaiukada, pwehki Eipraam e peikiong ie oh kapwaiada ei kosonned kan oh ei koasoandi koaros.”
Aisek eri kousoanla nan Kerar.
Ni ohl akan en wasao ar kin idek ihs Repeka, e kin ndahng irail me rie. E perki ndaiong irail me eh pwoud Repeka, pwe ohl en wasao de kemehla pwe re en kihsang Repeka, pwe liho me inenen kaselel.
Ni Aisek eh wereilahr wasao, Apimelek, nanmwarkien Pilisdia, ahpw mahsenieisang nan wenihmwtok ehu oh mahsanihada Aisek oh Repeka ara wiewia nsenen pwopwoud.
E ahpw malipehdo Aisek oh mahsanihong, “Uhdahn omw pwoud lih menen, a dahme ke ndahki me riomw?” Aisek ahpw sapengki, “I perki pwe aramas akan de kemehkiniehla ma I pahn nda me ei pwoud.”
Apimelek ahpw mahsanih, “Dahme ke wiahkihong kiht soangen piht wet? Emen ohl pwukat kakete engda rehn omw pwouden oh kowe me pahn pwukoahkihdi sapwung wet.”
Apimelek ahpw mahsanihong aramas koaros koasoandi wet, “Mehmen me pahn kedirapwa ohl menet de eh pwoud pahn kamakamala.”
Aisek eri padokedi wahntuhke nan sahpwo, e ahpw dolung pak epwiki tohtohsang me e padokedi, pwe KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwahwih.
Rahn koaros e ahpw kin kekeirda nan eh paiamwahu, e lao wiahla ohl kepwehpwe men.
E naineki kiden sihpw oh kou, oh tohndoadoahk ngeder, kahrehda mehn Pilisdia kan kin peiriniong.
Mehn Pilisdia kan eri audekihla pwehl pwarer en pihl koaros me nein eh pahpao, Eipraam, tohndoadoahk kan weiradahr mahs.
Apimelek ahpw mahsanihong Aisek, “Eri kohkohweisang nan wehiet, pwe ke inenen kehlailsangkihtehr.”
Aisek eri mwesel kohkohla oh kauwada imwe impwal kan nan Wahun Kerar, wasa me e kousoanla ie ahnsou kis.
Aisek ahpw pwurehng weirada pwarer me weiweidahr nan mwehin Eipraam, me mehn Pilisdia ko audekilahr pwehl. E ahpw kihong eden pwarer ko soangen ahd kante me eh pahpao kihong eden pwarer ko mahsie.
Nein Aisek tohndoadoahk ko weirada pwarer ehu nan wahuo oh diarada pihl me pwepwengkida sang loale.
Silepen sihpw kei en Kerar ahpw akamaiong nein Aisek silepen sihpw ko, ketihtihki, “Aht pwarer men.” Ih me Aisek kadanekihki pwarero “Akamai.”
Re pil weirada ehu pwarer, re ahpw pil akamaikihda; e ahpw kadanekihla pwarero “Pelian.”

E ahpw mwekidsang wasao oh pil weirada ehu pwarer. Eri pwarer wet sohte akamaipe wiawi, e ahpw kadanekihla “Saledek.” Aisek ahpw mahsanih, “KAUN-O ketikihongkitailehr saledek pwe kitail en kousoan nan sahpwet, eri kitail pahn paiamwahula wasaht.”
Aisek ahpw mweselsang wasao oh kohdahla Peersepa.

Nipwongohte KAUN-O ketin pwarohng oh mahsanihong, “Ngehi me Koht en semomw Eipraam. Ke dehr masak mehkot; I kin ieiang uhk. I pahn kapaiaiukada oh kangederehla kadaudokomw kan pwehki ei inou ong ei ladu Eipraam.”
Aisek eri kauwada pei sarawi ehu wasao oh kaudokiong KAUN-O. Mwurin eh kauwada imwe impwal kan wasao, nah tohndoadoahk kan ahpw weirada pwarer ehu wasao.
Inou Nanpwungen Aisek oh Apimelek
Apimelek ketido sang Kerar, iangahki sapwellime sounkaweid Ahusad oh Pikol, kaunen sounpeio, pwe re en tuhwong Aisek.
Aisek eri idek rehrail, “Dahme kumwail ketikihdo rehi met, nan amwail sohte kupwurkin ie oh kausiesang nan sapwellimamwail wehi?”
A re sapeng, “Met se eseier me KAUN-O kin ketin ieiang komwi, iei me se koasoanehdi pwe kitail en wiahda inou nanpwungatail. Se men komwi en inoukihda

me komwi sohte pahn wiahiong kiht mehkot suwed, duwehte at sohte wiahiong komwi mehkot suwed. Se kadek ong komwi oh mweidohng komwi en mweselsang reht ni popohl. Eri e uhdahn sansal me KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwahwihkomwier.”
Aisek eri kamadipweirailda, irail eri konot oh sakau.
Nimensehngie en mandahn rahno, re ahpw wiahda ar inou oh kahula. Aisek eri kamwurirailla, re ahpw ketiketla ni popohl.
Ni rahnohte nein Aisek tohndoadoahngko ahpw pwarodo oh kairehki duwen pwarer me re weiradahr. Re ndahng, “Se diaradahr pihl.”
Ih eri kihong eden pwarero “Inou.” Ih me kahnimw en wasao adanekihki Peersepa.
En Esau eh Pwoud en Liki kan
Ni Esau eh sounpar 40, e pwoudikihda serepein en Id riemen; Sudid, nein Peeri, oh Pasemad, nein Elon.
Serepein pwukat koaros kahrehiong en Aisek oh Repeka ara nsensuwed mehlel.
